source_group_rule: If parent_filepath is present, source_group is the parent's recording_id; otherwise source_group is the row's recording_id.
positive_group_policy: Largest positive source group -> test; second-largest -> validation; remaining positive source groups -> train.
remaining_group_policy: Deterministic largest-first greedy assignment minimizing normalized deviation from overall and per-category targets.
session_id_policy: NA: no session_id field exists in the input manifest.
speaker_policy: Preserve speaker_id exactly after whitespace normalization; composite IDs remain composite. Speaker-level separation is reported but not forced because the available composite speaker IDs form one connected component.
